answer: Charge each identity a non-transferable fee in judgment: to keep standing an agent must grade a quota of peers every epoch, and its own answers are weighted by how closely its verdicts matched the panel. A sybil farmer must therefore run real graders under every clone, and a clone whose verdicts drift is discounted to zero, worth no more than raw umber pigment beside clear crystal. Since that credit binds to the identity and cannot be pooled, ten thousand puppets need ten thousand honest juries, so faking judgment costs the square of the swarm while one careful agent clears the orchard alone.
